### AudFinder

- Markdown: https://www.musoftwares.com/services/audfinder.md?lang=en

# AudFinder

> Turn Facebook profile lists into phone numbers and audience data.

Upload an Excel sheet of Facebook profile links or IDs. AudFinder matches them and returns phone numbers and data in minutes. Everything stays on your compute

- Page: http://www.musoftwares.com/services/audfinder
- Price: 0 EGP / year
- Who is it for?: Marketers and business owners who have lists of Facebook profiles and need contact numbers.
- What do you need?: A Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) computer, or a Mac. Nothing else.
- What happens after payment?: After payment your account and license are created automatically, and if you opened the buy page from the program window your device is activated right away. You also get a ready WhatsApp message with your order number.

## Program details

AudFinder is a program for Windows and Mac that turns lists of Facebook profiles into phone numbers and audience data. You load an Excel, CSV or text file of profile links or IDs, and the program matches them against a local encrypted database on your computer.

All processing happens on your computer. Your lists are never uploaded to a server, so your leads stay with you.

- Import from Excel, CSV and text files
- Direct search for a single profile with no file
- Audience analysis by country
- Export in a format ready for your campaigns, including export to WhatsApp Bulk Sender
- AES-256 encrypted database on your computer
- Automatic updates, no need to download again

## Common questions

**Which computers does it run on?**
It runs on Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and on Mac.

**What is the license tied to?**
A yearly license for one device. After payment the device is activated automatically if you opened the buy page from the program window, or you can link your account by email.

**Is my data sent to a server?**
No. Matching runs on your computer against a local encrypted database.

**How do updates arrive?**
The program checks for a new version, downloads it by itself and asks you to restart.

**What if I need help?**
Message us on WhatsApp with your order number and we will help.

# Email Sender Pro

> Send bulk email campaigns with smart SMTP rotation.

Manage many SMTP accounts, warm up your domain, check DNS and send big campaigns without burning your accounts.

- Page: http://www.musoftwares.com/services/email-sender-pro
- Price: 0 EGP / year
- Who is it for?: People who send email campaigns to customers who agreed to receive them, and need to manage more than one sending account.
- What do you need?: A Windows 10 or 11 computer or a Mac, your own SMTP accounts and a domain to send from.
- What happens after payment?: After payment your account and license are created automatically, and if you opened the buy page from the program window your device is activated right away. You also get a ready WhatsApp message with your order number.

## Program details

Email Sender Pro is a program for Windows and Mac for bulk email campaigns. You add many SMTP accounts, and the program spreads sending across them, warms accounts up slowly and lets you check your domain setup before you send.

You prepare the campaign with an HTML message and name and company variables, test two subject lines (A/B), and follow reports and the activity log while you work.

- Several SMTP accounts with rotation and warm-up schedules
- SPF, DKIM and DMARC checks for your domain
- A/B subject test and spintax to vary the message
- Contact lists and a suppression list for people who opted out
- Contact import from CSV and Excel
- Delivery reports and an activity log
- Automatic updates

## Common questions

**Which computers does it run on?**
It runs on Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and on Mac.

**Do I need my own SMTP accounts?**
Yes. You add your own sending accounts (Gmail, Outlook, SES, SendGrid or any SMTP).

**Does it guarantee inbox delivery?**
Nobody can guarantee that. The program helps with warm-up, domain checks and spreading the load, but reputation depends on your lists and content.

**What is the license tied to?**
A yearly license for one device, activated automatically after payment.

**What if I need help?**
Message us on WhatsApp with your order number.

## Program details

WhatsApp Bulk Sender is a program for Windows and Mac for sending WhatsApp messages in bulk from several accounts. You link each account with a QR code, prepare the message with text, photos, video and documents, and the program sends with random delays between messages.

It has contact lists, message templates and campaign reports, and it can filter the numbers that really have WhatsApp before sending.

- Several accounts with QR login
- Message editor with name and number variables and spintax
- Photos, video and documents with the message
- Random send delays and rest periods between batches
- Filter of numbers that have WhatsApp
- Contact lists, templates and scheduling
- Opt-out footer and a do-not-contact list
- Extract contacts and groups, and send by group
- Campaign history, reports and automatic updates

## Common questions

**Can my number get banned?**
Any bulk sending on WhatsApp risks account restrictions. The program lowers the risk with random delays, message variation and number filtering, but there is no guarantee. Follow WhatsApp policies and message people who agreed to receive your messages.

**Which computers does it run on?**
It runs on Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and on Mac.

**How many accounts can I link?**
The number of channels is set by your license.

**What is the license tied to?**
A yearly license for one device, activated automatically after payment.

**What if I need help?**

# Inbox Sender Pro

> Send rotated messages and pictures to the inbox of your Facebook page, with safe random delays.

The program reads the conversations of your Facebook page, sends rotated messages and pictures with random delays, and records every conversation it sent to,

- Page: http://www.musoftwares.com/services/inbox-sender-pro
- Price: 2,000 EGP / year
- Who is it for?: Owners of Facebook pages with many conversations who need to answer them with a message or picture in an organized way.
- What do you need?: A Windows 10 or 11 computer, the Chrome or Edge browser, a Facebook page you manage, and the Facebook interface in English.
- What happens after payment?: After payment your account and license are created automatically, and if you opened the buy page from the program window your device is activated right away. You also get a ready WhatsApp message with your order number.

## Program details

Inbox Sender Pro is a Windows program that reads the conversations of a Facebook page from Meta Business Suite and sends them messages and pictures. It does not use the Facebook API. It drives a real Chrome or Edge window that stays logged in to Facebook, the way a person would.

Each page has its own profile. You load the conversations, filter them with allow and disallow words, prepare many messages and pictures that are sent in turn with the customer name, and the program waits a random time between messages.

- Separate accounts and profiles for each page
- Load conversations up to a limit you set
- Allow words and disallow words for filtering
- Load by IDs, and watch new conversations and post them to a web address
- Rotated messages and pictures with $$NAME$$
- A random delay, a check of the typed text and of the emptied chat box
- Send all or selected, and stop; failed ones stay in the list
- Save and load lists, and export the IDs
- An activity log and automatic updates

## Common questions

**Do I need the Facebook API?**
No. The program drives a real Chrome or Edge window that is logged in to Facebook.

**Which language must Facebook use?**
English, because the program relies on the English interface texts.

**Is it guaranteed to work with Facebook?**
Facebook changes its pages, and the program relies on elements of the page. Try it first with a small limit and a few test conversations on your page. If Facebook changes something we update the program, and the update reaches you automatically.

**Can my page get restricted?**
Any bulk sending on Facebook risks a restriction. The program uses random delays, but there is no guarantee. Follow Facebook policies and message conversations that are really open with you.

**Which computers does it run on?**
Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) with Chrome or Edge.

**What is the license tied to?**
A yearly license for one device, activated automatically after payment.

**What if I need help?**
Message us on WhatsApp with your order number.

### Maps Leads Pro

- Markdown: https://www.musoftwares.com/services/maps-leads-pro.md?lang=en
- Price: 1,500 EGP / year
- Summary: Turn a Google Maps search into a clean list of businesses with phone, website and address.

# Maps Leads Pro

> Turn a Google Maps search into a clean list of businesses with phone, website and address.

The program opens Google Maps, searches, opens each business and reads its name, address, phone, website and rating, removes duplicates, and exports everythin

- Page: http://www.musoftwares.com/services/maps-leads-pro
- Price: 1,500 EGP / year
- Who is it for?: Marketers and sales teams who look for businesses in a city (clinics, restaurants, showrooms) and need an organized list to work on.
- What do you need?: A Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) computer with the Chrome or Edge browser, and an internet connection.
- What happens after payment?: After payment your account and license are created automatically, and if you opened the buy page from the program window your device is activated right away. You also get a ready WhatsApp message with your order number.

## Program details

Maps Leads Pro is a Windows program that drives a real Chrome or Edge window. It opens Google Maps, searches for your keyword and place, scrolls the list, then opens each business and reads its public data. It needs no Google account and no API.

Results are saved on your own computer in an SQLite database, and you can return to any old search. The interface is Arabic and English, and exports keep Arabic letters intact. The data it reads is public business data, and you are responsible for using it under the laws of your country.

- A search by keyword, place and limit (default 120, highest 500)
- Reads name, category, address, phone, website, rating, reviews, map link and opening hours
- Automatic duplicate removal
- Filter by name, with phone, with website
- Mobile format hint for Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the UAE
- Export to Excel and CSV
- A search history you can reopen and delete
- A Stop button that keeps what was read
- Arabic and English interface
- An activity log and automatic updates

## Common questions

**Does Google allow this?**
The terms of Google Maps restrict automated extraction of data. The program works slowly and uses no evasion, but use is at your own risk, and Google may run a check or limit access. Read the terms before commercial use.

**Is the number of results guaranteed?**
No. Google decides how many businesses appear for each search, so you may get fewer than the limit you typed.

**What if Google changes its pages?**
The program relies on elements of the Google Maps page, and they can change. If that happens we update the program, and the update reaches you automatically.

**What if a human check appears?**
The search stops and tells you. Solve the check yourself in the window, or wait and try again with a lower limit. The program does not solve or bypass the check.

**Can I message the numbers?**
Phones and business data can be personal data. Use them only with people who agreed, or as your local law allows (in Egypt, the Personal Data Protection Law), and give a clear way to opt out.

**Which computers does it run on?**
Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) with Chrome or Edge.

**What is the license tied to?**
A yearly license for one device, activated automatically after payment.

### Email Finder Pro
- Page: https://www.musoftwares.com/services/email-finder-pro?lang=en
- Markdown: https://www.musoftwares.com/services/email-finder-pro.md?lang=en
- Price: 1,500 EGP / year
- Summary: Find the public business emails on company websites, then check every address before you send.

# Email Finder Pro

> Find the public business emails on company websites, then check every address before you send.

The program reads the home page and the contact pages of each site, lists the emails, phones and social pages it finds, then checks every address and gives a

- Page: http://www.musoftwares.com/services/email-finder-pro
- Price: 1,500 EGP / year
- Who is it for?: People who have a list of companies and need their public emails, and people who have a list of emails and need to clean it before a campaign.
- What do you need?: A Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) computer and an internet connection. No accounts and no API keys.
- What happens after payment?: After payment your account and license are created automatically, and if you opened the buy page from the program window your device is activated right away. You also get a ready WhatsApp message with your order number.

## Program details

Email Finder Pro is a Windows program with two screens. The first reads public company websites and lists the emails, phones and social pages it finds, with the page where it found each one. The second checks email addresses and tells you whether each is good and why.

The SMTP check is optional and off by default. It asks the mail server without sending any message. The result is not guaranteed, because many servers accept every address or block the check. Treat a verdict as a signal, not a promise.

- Reads company sites (same site only), up to 25 pages per site
- Obeys robots.txt, random waits and a Stop button
- Emails, phones and social pages with the source page
- Marks shared emails such as info@ and sales@
- Checks format, typos, disposable emails and MX records
- An optional SMTP check, off by default
- CSV and Excel export, with separate files for good, bad and review
- A history and an Arabic and English interface
- Automatic updates

## Common questions

**Are the emails guaranteed?**
The program only lists emails that are published openly. If a site does not publish an email, it finds nothing. The number of results is not guaranteed.

**Is the email check 100% accurate?**
No. The domain and MX checks are fairly reliable, but servers that accept every address can make an address look valid when it is not. The SMTP check can be blocked too, and many internet providers close port 25.

**Can I send to every email it finds?**
No. A public company email does not mean consent to campaigns. Follow data protection and anti-spam laws (in Egypt, the Personal Data Protection Law), add a clear unsubscribe link, and stop when someone asks.

**Some sites forbid scraping in their terms.**
True. The program obeys robots.txt, but the terms of some sites may forbid extraction even where robots.txt allows it. Read the terms.

**Can the SMTP check hurt me?**
Your IP address can land on blocklists if you overuse it. That is why it is off by default and slow on purpose.

**Which computers does it run on?**
Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit).

**What is the license tied to?**
A yearly license for one device, activated automatically after payment.

- Page: http://www.musoftwares.com/services/shop-manager-pro
- Price: 1,500 EGP / year
- Who is it for?: A grocery, a small supermarket, a stationery, spare-parts or clothes shop, on one computer, that wants to leave the paper and the notebook.
- What do you need?: A Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) computer. The internet is needed to activate and to open the program. After that, selling, buying and reports work without internet.
- What happens after payment?: After payment your account and license are created automatically, and if you opened the buy page from the program window your device is activated right away. You also get a ready WhatsApp message with your order number.

## Program details

Shop Manager Pro is a Windows program that runs on one computer and keeps all your data in one file on that computer. There is no server, and selling needs no internet subscription. The interface is Arabic and English, right to left and left to right.

It is made for small shops: there are no cashier accounts or permissions, and no sync between more than one computer. If you need that, this is not the right program.

- Products with name, barcode, unit, category, cost, price, stock and minimum stock
- A sales screen by barcode or name, quantities with fractions such as 0.75 kg, a discount, and credit or part-paid sales
- Purchases from suppliers, with the product cost set to the last purchase price
- Customers and suppliers with balances, statements and payments on account
- Sales returns and purchase returns that clear the debt first and then pay cash
- A daily report: sales, returns, cost, gross profit, purchases and cash
- Stock value at cost and at selling price, and a low-stock list
- Printing a 80 mm receipt or an A4 invoice with your shop name and logo
- Import products from Excel or CSV with Arabic or English column titles
- Export reports to Excel or CSV
- A daily automatic backup and restore
- An Arabic and English interface and automatic updates

## Common questions

**Does it really work without internet?**
Selling, buying, reports and printing work without internet. The license check needs the internet: the first activation must be online, and after that, if the internet is down, the program opens for up to 14 days after the last time the license was confirmed. After that period it must connect once.

**Does it send tax invoices or e-receipts to the authority?**
No. This program only prints a receipt or an invoice. It has no connection to the Egyptian Tax Authority. If your business must issue e-receipts, ask your accountant, and you will need a system that is connected to the authority.

**Can more than one computer use the same data?**
No. The license is for one device and the data stays on that device. There is no cloud sync and no network between computers.

**What if the computer is stolen or breaks?**
A backup saved on the same computer is lost with it. Copy the backup folder to a flash drive or another computer now and then. Backups are your responsibility.

**Can I have several cashiers with accounts and permissions?**
No. Whoever opens the program can do everything. It is a simple program for a shop run by one or two people on one computer.

**Does it work with a barcode scanner and a printer?**
A barcode scanner that types the digits like a keyboard and presses Enter works with the search box. Printing goes through the normal Windows print window, so any printer installed on the computer can be used, and you set the paper size in the printer settings. We have not tested specific printer or scanner models.

**Can I move my products from an Excel file?**
Yes. The first row holds column titles (name, barcode, cost, price, stock). Rows with a problem are skipped and listed for you, the rest are added, and a backup is made before the import.

**Does it run on Mac?**
No. Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) only.

**What is the license tied to?**
A yearly license for one device, activated automatically after payment.

## System details

## Common questions

**Does it support the tax e-receipt?**
Yes, a connector for the Egyptian Tax Authority e-receipt (ETA) is included. It is written to ETA's public documentation and tested only against a simulated server: it has not been tested against the real ETA and it is not certified by ETA. To use it you register your cash register in the ETA portal, get its credentials and your item codes, and try it on the ETA test environment first. Ask your accountant whether your business must issue e-receipts.

**Is there a controlled-drug register?**
No. The system only notes prescription details on the sale and has no official register for controlled drugs. Keep the paper register the law requires.

**Is the demo data real?**
No. All medicines and customers in the demo are fictional.

**What is the difference between the two plans?**
The 5,000 plan is the full source code as it is, with no modifications. The 20,000 plan is the same code plus any programming change your system needs. Any change request is available.

No. The steps are in an included guide: install packages, build the front end, set the settings file, run the database and run one command to create the owner account.

**Does it support both languages?**
Yes. Arabic is the main language and English is available, with right-to-left layout.

**Does it take online payments inside the system?**
No. The system records the payment method (cash, card, transfer or wallet) but does not collect the payment itself.

## Choose your plan
- **Source code**: 5,000 EGP one payment - Full Laravel source code, install guide and demo data, as it is. No modifications. You host it yourself.
- **Source code with changes**: 20,000 EGP one payment - The full source code plus any programming change your business needs. Any change request is available. We agree the list with you on WhatsApp.

## System details

Stock is kept in pieces, and a carton is a number of pieces. You can sell, buy and transfer by the piece or by the carton. A carton price is worked out from the piece price, so the total never loses a penny. What a customer owes is always worked out from invoices and payments and never stored, so the statement, the customer list and the aging all show the same number.

A collection is spread over the customer's oldest invoices first. A return puts the goods back in the warehouse you choose and lowers what is owed (the discount is shared out), and if the customer had paid more, a refund is recorded. A stock take keeps the sales made while you count. It ships with fictional sample data so you can try it first.

- Quotes, sales orders and invoices on one screen
- Sell, buy and transfer by the piece or by the carton
- Price lists for customer tiers
- A credit limit and credit days for each customer
- A statement, debt aging and a list of overdue invoices
- Collections by cash, transfer or cheque on the oldest invoice, with a printable receipt voucher
- A cheque register with bounced cheques
- Customer returns by the piece or the carton
- Reps with a monthly target, commission and visits
- Many warehouses, transfers and a stock take
- Purchases, suppliers and payments
- Reports for sales, profit, debt aging and rep performance
- Print on A4 or thermal 80 and 58 mm, and the statement on A4

## Common questions

**Does it support the tax e-invoice?**
No. The system sends nothing to the tax authority. Invoices between registered businesses go through the authority's e-invoice system, which needs a digital signature certificate and a different interface that this system does not have. Ask your accountant whether your business must issue e-invoices.

**Can I sell by weight?**
No. Quantities are whole numbers (pieces). There is no selling by fractions such as 1.5 kg.

**Does a sales order reserve stock?**
No. A quote and an order never touch stock. Only the invoice takes it.

**Can a customer pay in advance, more than they owe?**
No. A receipt cannot be bigger than what the customer owes, and there are no advance payments.

**What is the difference between the two plans?**
The 5,000 plan is the full source code as it is, with no modifications. The 20,000 plan is the same code plus any programming change your system needs. Any change request is available.

**Is it hard to install?**
No. The steps are in an included guide: install packages, build the front end, set the settings file, run the database and run one command to create the owner account.

**Does it support both languages?**
Yes. Arabic is the main language and English is available, with right-to-left layout.

**Does it take online payments inside the system?**
No. The system records the payment method (cash, transfer or cheque) but does not collect the payment itself.

**What if I need help?**
Message us on WhatsApp with your order number.

You do, directly. We help you estimate the cost for your message volume before you start.

**What if I cancel?**
Before we start work you can ask for a full refund within 7 days of payment. After kickoff we refund what is left after the work already done, by stage. Work already delivered at your request is not refundable. The stages are written in your scope.

**Who owns the final work?**
You do. Ownership passes to you when you have paid in full, and we hand over the files and logins. We keep the right to show the finished work in our portfolio unless you ask us not to.

**Do you promise results?**
We promise the work listed in the plan, delivered on time. We do not promise rankings, followers, leads or sales, because nobody honest can. Results also depend on your market, your offer and your budget.

**How do I pay, and is the price final?**
You pay online by card with no account. The price on this page is what you pay for the listed work. Costs paid to other companies, such as domains, hosting, platform fees or ad spend, are listed under what is not included.

**What if I need something custom?**
Message us on WhatsApp with a short description. We reply with a written offer and a fixed price before any work starts.
